plaquette.painsTitle: Three sentences I hear before every engagement

pains.pain: “Nobody knows how it works any more.”
pains.answer: The original team has gone, there are no tests and the documentation is patchy, and every fix breaks something else. I map the system and put a safety net of tests over the critical paths before touching anything.

pains.pain: “We are being told to rewrite everything.”
pains.answer: It is the riskiest project a company can start: double the budget, two years without a new feature, and the old system still running. I break the existing one down piece by piece, each step shippable and reversible.

pains.pain: “We have been talking about AI for two years, nothing is live.”
pains.answer: Because it is treated as a demo instead of an engineering problem. I embed models in the product, with the reviews and the tests that go with them. And if your data must not leave your walls, they run inside them.

plaquette.trustTitle: They put their trust in me
plaquette.trustNote: Earlier, Amadeus IT and Cora. The platforms I tooled today serve campaigns for UNICEF and for the Paris Saint-Germain endowment fund.
plaquette.missionsTitle: What that looks like in practice

missions.title: Producing a site no longer requires a developer
missions.body: At the start, every site went through a developer: a bottleneck on each new campaign. As a pair with the CTO, seven months to deliver a studio anyone on the team uses without writing code. The AI writes the site, the tool assembles it, the pipeline publishes it.
missions.proof: Its CTO has trusted me since 2015.

missions.title: Two bespoke builds turned into one configurable platform
missions.body: Design of the foundation that made it possible to generalise an AI document generation tool, then the gradual dismantling of the monolith into independent services.

missions.title: A matching engine that unlocks cross-selling across the network
missions.body: Automatic matching of the network's properties against buyers' criteria, including properties never listed online.
missions.proof: France's leading estate agent network, 14,000 advisors.

missions.title: An acquired application secured, then brought in-house
missions.body: Taken over with no tests and only patchy documentation, put back into production inside the group's ecosystem, then the professional accounts migrated to stop paying their incumbent provider.
